scope: Ignite:Ignite official preset listing demo inspected read-only via rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper actions, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Ignite preset listing View demo opened the Ignite Tech & Gadgets Co storefront.

claims.observed: Rendered Smart Tech catalog exposes technical facets and a compare control; Edge Pixa 9 product page exposes variant choices and a technical specification table.
claims.risk: Visible controls do not prove functional filtering/comparison or factual accuracy of compatibility, specifications, inventory or reviews.
claims.vsn_guard: Test catalog and compare behavior and validate merchant-supplied device attributes before using them as product data.

claims.observed: Demo pages display sale, trade-in, delivery, discount, stock and customer-rating messages.
claims.risk: Sample copy does not substantiate live prices, inventory, shipping terms, discounts or reviews.
claims.vsn_guard: Require a source and validation path for each promotional, inventory, delivery and review claim.
